articles.title: Bitcoin price tags $84.6K as US stocks head higher on SpaceX Q3 earnings beat
articles.snippet: Bitcoin extended gains to approach $85,000 after US stock markets reacted to higher-than-expected SpaceX earnings.

articles.title: Standard Chartered signs definitive deal to acquire Zodia Custody
articles.snippet: The signing follows shareholders’ acceptance of Standard Chartered’s non-binding offer in May, with regulatory approvals still pending.

articles.title: PancakeSwap TVL tops $380M as major fee overhaul heads to vote
articles.snippet: PancakeSwap’s proposed fee-sharing overhaul would give liquidity providers 88% of swap fees and cut CAKE emissions by 69%, as BNB Chain’s DeFi activity expands.

articles.title: Qubic restarts blockchain, opens recovery claims after $1.4M hack
articles.snippet: The network’s validators approved a recovery plan and opened claims until May 1, 2027.

articles.title: Bitwise, Hyperliquid seek SEC rule changes for token trading, airdrops
articles.snippet: The firms are seeking clearer guidance on the classification of crypto assets and secondary-market trading as the SEC’s public comment period comes to a close.
